usage: __main__.py [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--list]
                   [{array,intensities,scan,snv,motifs,calibrate_max_probes,calibrate_mask,pipeline}]

Print or copy a commented EUbar YAML template.

positional arguments:
  {array,intensities,scan,snv,motifs,calibrate_max_probes,calibrate_mask,pipeline}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        Write template to this file instead of stdout
  --list                List available templates
